sources.title: Anhui University 2026-2027 Chinese Government Scholarship University Program brochure

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen in good physical and mental health.
Hold a bachelor's degree and be under 35 years old.
Hold a master's degree and be under 40 years old.
For Chinese-taught study, provide HSK Level 5 with at least 210. For English-taught study, provide TOEFL 75 or IELTS 6.0.
Submit a passport whose validity extends beyond September 2026.
Submit the notarized highest diploma and academic transcripts; expected graduates may submit official expected-graduation proof.

references.locator: Page 8, Application Documents, diploma and transcript rows

requirements.ruleText: Submit both an Anhui University supervisor acceptance letter and the university pre-admission notice required by the brochure.

references.locator: Page 8, Application Documents, acceptance and pre-admission rows

requirements.ruleText: Submit a study or research plan longer than 1,000 words; doctoral plans must be signed by the intended supervisor.
Submit two recommendation letters from professors or associate professors.
Submit a Foreigner Physical Examination Form valid within six months.
Submit a certificate of no criminal record issued within six months.
Submit between January 15, 2026 at 08:00 and March 15, 2026 at 17:00, as stated in the brochure.

sources.title: UIBE international undergraduate programs offered in English

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants to UIBE English-taught undergraduate programs
requirements.ruleText: Hold a high-school diploma and be in good health.
Submit the notarized guardianship certificate required by UIBE.
Complete the UIBE online application form.
Submit a copy of the high-school graduation certificate and transcripts.
Submit a copy of the guarantor's passport or identity document.
Submit the CSCA certificate for Mathematics.
Submit a copy of the passport or other accepted identification.
Submit two recent passport photographs with white background, frontal view and no hat.
Submit TOEFL 86, IELTS 6.0, A Level BBC or above, an accepted equivalent result, or official proof that high-school instruction was fully in English.
Submit an asset certificate showing funds sufficient to cover tuition.
Submit a certificate of no criminal conviction.
Use the recurring application periods stated by UIBE: October 20 to December 31 for spring entry, and March 20 to June 30 for fall entry.
Pay the non-refundable RMB 660 application fee.

requirements.ruleText: Be a high-school graduate or above and meet university admission qualifications.
Be a non-Chinese citizen in good physical and mental health, hold a valid private passport, and agree to follow Chinese law and university regulations.
Applicants must be age 18-25; applicants under 18 must provide guardian documents for Beijing.
Meet the Ministry of Education requirements referenced as Document No. 12 (2020).
Submit either the UIBE or BUCT application form through the relevant official application portal.
Submit a curriculum vitae and personal statement.
Submit the passport photo page and Chinese visa pages when applicable.
Submit a notarized high-school diploma and transcripts.
Submit IELTS 6.0, TOEFL 85, or an accepted equivalent result.
Submit CSCA results for Mathematics and Chemistry.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form.
Submit a certificate of no criminal record.
Submit by June 30, 2026.
Pay the RMB 660 application fee. Payment account details are intentionally excluded from this dataset.

sources.title: Shanghai University of Political Science and Law 2026 international student admission guide

requirements.ruleText: Be age 18-30 and have at least a high-school-level education. Scholarship routes may impose separate conditions.
Submit a valid CSCA score report. The linked subject attachment must be checked for program-specific subjects.

references.locator: Heading '四、申请材料', CSCA row; heading '七、报名流程', step 1

requirements.ruleText: Submit the highest diploma; documents not in Chinese or English must be translated and notarized.
Submit the transcript for the highest completed education; documents not in Chinese or English must be translated and notarized.
Submit a financial guarantee letter or personal bank-deposit certificate. If using a guarantor, include the guarantor's signature and passport identity page.
Submit a Foreigner Physical Examination Form issued within six months.
Submit a passport copy and passport-style photograph.
Submit a certificate of no criminal record issued within six months.
Submit the applicable HSK certificate. The general guide does not state a universal minimum score.

references.locator: Heading '四、申请材料', Chinese-language certificate row

requirements.ruleText: Submit a study or research plan; the guide marks it optional for undergraduate applicants.
Submit two recommendation letters in Chinese or English from professors or associate professors. Undergraduate applicants may provide them when available.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants currently working or studying in China
requirements.ruleText: Submit current-study or departure proof and a copy of the temporary residence permit as applicable.
Submit the specified electronic identification photograph and a one-minute self-introduction video in Chinese for Chinese-taught programs or English for English-taught programs.
